svg.text: provider order and thresholds are set in config (defaults shown)
LLM failover with a circuit breaker per provider, and reduced-mode behaviour for every other dependency
Each switch is recorded as a LangSmith tag
2 retries → answer from MCP data and memory,
skip MCP tools; answer from documents and
name the data that was missing
429 + Retry-After; UI shows when to retry
app keeps working; tracing errors only logged
Every row has a resilience test (pytest -m resilience) and is shown live by stopping a container.
Agents write errors to their own state slot; the supervisor retries, skips or answers with what it has.
